title: Snapshot (full state roll-up)
description: DESCRIPTIVE, NOT NORMATIVE. Generated from firmware source at FW 1.8.0, which is the WORKING TREE and is not committed. The nearest commit is dcdd0dc, which is a different firmware version - do not read x-commit as containing this behaviour. This is not a specification and not a proposal; it records what the device emits today. Plane: D2C telemetry. `required` lists only keys present in the minimal payload, i.e. those always emitted for this message type.

schema.description: Wire-contract identifier. Constant; bump signals a breaking payload change. Range/enum: Fixed literal "eflostop.v2".

ts.description: Device wall-clock at message BUILD time. The whole message is destroyed (never sent, never buffered) if ts < 1704067200, so a pre-SNTP leak event is lost permanently. Units: seconds (Unix epoch, UTC). Range/enum: >= 1704067200 (2024-01-01T00:00:00Z).

id.description: Immutable hub id derived from the WiFi STA MAC in eFuse. Same string used as the DPS registration id and the MQTT client id. Range/enum: "GW-" + 12 uppercase hex.

short_id.description: Last 2 bytes of the STA MAC as 4 hex chars. Also the SoftAP SSID suffix (WiFi-Hub-XXXX) the installer matches during setup. Range/enum: 4 uppercase hex chars.

name.description: User-assigned hub name from twin desired hub_name or C2D set_hub_name. NOTE the opposite convention on the twin plane, where hub_name is always emitted as "". Range/enum: free text, max 31 chars (HUB_NAME_MAX_LEN). Presence: conditional: OMITTED when the stored name is empty.

fw.description: Hub firmware version, read at runtime from the ESP-IDF app descriptor (PROJECT_VER). Never a hardcoded string. Range/enum: "1.8.0" in the working tree (CMakeLists.txt:12); "0.0.0" if the descriptor is empty.

uptime_s.description: Seconds since boot from the monotonic esp_timer. On an offline-buffer replay this is the ORIGINAL build-time value, possibly from a previous boot. Units: seconds. Range/enum: >= 0.

type.description: Envelope discriminator. Tells the backend which `data` shape to expect. Range/enum: enum: "lifecycle" | "snapshot" | "event".

reason.description: TWO DISTINCT MEANINGS ON ONE PATH. In a snapshot it is the trigger that caused the snapshot. In the auto_close_reenabled rules event it is the cause of the override cancellation. Range/enum: enum, 7 values total. snapshot: heartbeat | event | commission | boot | fast | decommission. rules event: c2d_command. Presence: snapshot: always in practice; rules event: always.
reason.x-source: snapshot main/telemetry/telemetry_v2.c:383 with main/iothub/app_iothub.c:581-591 and :1570; rules event main/rules_engine/rules_engine.c:722

rating.description: Worst rating across all provisioned devices. Does NOT track leak state, so it can read "excellent" while the hub's fleet LED is RED for a valve flood. Range/enum: enum: excellent | good | warning | critical | unknown. Presence: always (snapshot only).
rating.x-source: main/telemetry/telemetry_v2.c:391-394; source main/health_engine/health_engine.c:57-66; LED asymmetry main/rgb/fleet_led.c:149-156

reason.description: Comma-joined human-readable cause list built from the devices sitting at the system rating. Free text intended for display, not parsing. Range/enum: free text, max 127 chars; "All devices healthy" when rating is excellent; "Degraded" fallback; "Health data unavailable" on a health mutex timeout. Presence: always (snapshot only).

system_health.description: Fleet roll-up container: the single worst device rating plus a human-readable cause. Presence: always (snapshot only).

mac.description: Valve BLE MAC. Prefers the live link, falls back to the provisioned health record so a disconnected valve still identifies itself. Range/enum: colon-separated MAC. Presence: conditional: OMITTED when neither the live BLE link nor a health record has a MAC.

state.description: Valve position. "disconnected" is emitted in place of a position when the BLE link is down, so this field mixes position and link state. Range/enum: enum: open | closed | unknown | disconnected (unknown = characteristic byte is neither 0 nor 1). Presence: always (snapshot only).

battery.description: Valve battery from GATT byte 0. Reads 0 between CONNECTED and GATT-setup completion, indistinguishable from a genuinely flat battery. Units: percent. Range/enum: 0..255 as emitted; header intent is 0..100. Presence: conditional: OMITTED when the valve is disconnected.

leak_state.description: Water detected AT THE VALVE body (its own flood sensor), distinct from the remote leak sensors. Range/enum: true | false. Presence: conditional: OMITTED when the valve is disconnected.

rmleak.description: The valve's remote-leak interlock latch. While true the valve refuses to open, and the hub refuses to forward a valve_open command. Range/enum: true | false. Presence: conditional: OMITTED when the valve is disconnected.

connected.description: Whether the valve GATT link is currently up. The authoritative liveness flag; there is NO valve_disconnected event. Range/enum: true | false. Presence: always (snapshot only).

fw_version.description: Valve firmware revision from the BLE Device Information Service, copied verbatim with no format validation. Range/enum: free text, max 31 chars. Presence: THREE-STATE: string when read; explicit null when connected but DIS read failed; key ABSENT when disconnected.
fw_version.x-source: main/telemetry/telemetry_v2.c:436-440 (string or null), and absent via the :441 else-branch

rating.description: Valve health rating from the health engine (connection + battery), independent of leak state. Range/enum: enum: excellent | good | warning | critical | unknown. Presence: conditional: OMITTED when the valve has no health record.

last_seen_age_s.description: Seconds since the valve was last heard from. Units: seconds. Range/enum: >= 0 when a number. Presence: THREE-STATE: number when known; explicit null when UINT32_MAX (never seen); key ABSENT when the valve has no health record.

valve.description: Live valve state container. Always present even when the valve is disconnected. Presence: always (snapshot only).

sensor_id.description: LoRa sensor id as rendered by the health engine. Range/enum: "0x" + 8 uppercase hex, e.g. 0x754A6237. Presence: always for each element.

connected.description: Heard within the LoRa health timeout. Also gates whether the cached radio values below are merged at all. Range/enum: true | false. Presence: always for each element.

rating.description: Health rating from timeout + battery + RSSI thresholds. Range/enum: enum: excellent | good | warning | critical | unknown. Presence: always for each element.

last_seen_age_s.description: Seconds since this sensor last checked in. Units: seconds. Range/enum: >= 0 when a number. Presence: always present; explicit null when UINT32_MAX (never heard).

battery.description: Battery from the decrypted LoRa frame. Units: percent. Range/enum: 0..255 as emitted; sender intent 0..100. Presence: always present; explicit null when there is no live cache entry.

leak_state.description: Leak flag. DERIVED WITH A DIFFERENT TEST from the leak event: the snapshot uses leak_status == 1 while the event uses leak_status != 0, so a sensor reporting 2 would auto-close the valve yet read leak_state:false in every snapshot. Range/enum: true | false. Presence: always present; hard-coded false (NOT null) when there is no live cache entry.
leak_state.x-source: main/telemetry/telemetry_v2.c:500-501 (== 1) vs main/iothub/app_iothub.c:1750 (!= 0); no-cache placeholder main/telemetry/telemetry_v2.c:506

rssi.description: Received signal strength of the last LoRa frame. Can be POSITIVE (67..127) because the SX127x driver's int result is narrowed to int8_t, wrapping any true RSSI below -128 dBm. Units: dBm. Range/enum: int8_t: -128..127 (negative is normal; 67..127 indicates a wrapped value). Presence: always present; explicit null when there is no live cache entry.

snr.description: LoRa signal-to-noise ratio. The ONLY non-integer number on the whole wire: quarter-dB steps, serialized bare (e.g. 9) when integral and as 9.25 / 9.5 / 9.75 otherwise. Units: dB. Range/enum: -32.00..+31.75 in 0.25 steps. Presence: always present; explicit null when there is no live cache entry.

code.description: Machine-readable room code from the sensor_meta table; "unknown" when no metadata is stored. Range/enum: enum, 13 values: unknown | bathroom | kitchen | laundry | garage | garden | basement | utility | hallway | bedroom | living_room | attic | outdoor. Presence: always for each element.

label.description: User-entered free-text location label. Range/enum: free text, max 31 chars. Presence: always for each element; "" when no metadata is stored.

location.description: Installed-location metadata container. ALWAYS emitted here, unlike the omit-when-unknown convention used by the rules engine's auto_close event. Presence: always for each element (never omitted).

lora_sensors.description: One entry per COMMISSIONED LoRa leak sensor, driven by the health table (not the radio cache). Range/enum: array of objects. Presence: always (snapshot only); empty array when no LoRa sensors or health is unavailable.

sensor_id.description: BLE leak sensor MAC as rendered by the health engine. Range/enum: colon-separated MAC. Presence: always for each element.

connected.description: Heard within the BLE-leak health timeout. Also gates the cache merge below. Range/enum: true | false. Presence: always for each element.

rating.description: Health rating from timeout + battery + RSSI thresholds. Range/enum: enum: excellent | good | warning | critical | unknown. Presence: always for each element.

last_seen_age_s.description: Seconds since this sensor's last advertisement was accepted. Units: seconds. Range/enum: >= 0 when a number. Presence: always present; explicit null when UINT32_MAX (never heard).

battery.description: Battery from manufacturer-data byte 3 of the eleak advertisement. Units: percent. Range/enum: 0..255 as emitted; header intent 0..100. Presence: always present; explicit null when there is no live cache entry.

leak_state.description: Leak flag from manufacturer-data byte 2, tested != 0 (consistent with the BLE leak event, unlike the LoRa path). Range/enum: true | false. Presence: always present; hard-coded false (NOT null) when there is no live cache entry.

rssi.description: Advertisement RSSI as reported by NimBLE (no narrowing bug on this path). Units: dBm. Range/enum: int8_t, typically -100..-20. Presence: always present; explicit null when there is no live cache entry.

fw_version.description: Sensor firmware version, built ONLY when the advertisement carries >= 7 bytes of manufacturer data. A 4-byte (older) payload leaves this permanently null. Range/enum: "M.m.p", max 11 chars. Presence: always present; explicit null when the cache has no version OR there is no cache entry.

code.description: Machine-readable room code; "unknown" when no metadata is stored. Range/enum: enum, 13 values: unknown | bathroom | kitchen | laundry | garage | garden | basement | utility | hallway | bedroom | living_room | attic | outdoor. Presence: always for each element.

label.description: User-entered free-text location label. Range/enum: free text, max 31 chars. Presence: always for each element; "" when no metadata is stored.

location.description: Installed-location metadata container. Presence: always for each element (never omitted).

ble_leak_sensors.description: One entry per COMMISSIONED BLE leak sensor, driven by the health table. Range/enum: array of objects. Presence: always (snapshot only); empty array when none or health is unavailable.

auto_close_enabled.description: Master switch: does a leak automatically close the valve. Range/enum: true | false. Presence: present whenever data.rules is present.

trigger_mask.description: Which leak sources may trigger auto-close. bit0=BLE leak, bit1=LoRa, bit2=valve flood. NOTHING masks or validates the inbound value, so the emitted range is 0..255, not 0..7. Units: bitmask. Range/enum: 0..255 on the wire (only bits 0-2 are interpreted). Presence: present whenever data.rules is present.
trigger_mask.x-source: main/telemetry/telemetry_v2.c:362, :581; bits main/provisioning_manager/provisioning_manager.h:22-25; unmasked cast main/rules_engine/rules_engine.c:562 and main/provisioning_manager/provisioning_manager.c:486

rules.description: Global auto-close configuration container. Byte-identical shape in lifecycle and snapshot so the backend reuses one parser. Presence: conditional: OMITTED if provisioning_get_rules_config() fails (mutex timeout / not initialised).

override_active.description: Is the 24 h water-access override window open (auto-close suppressed). Range/enum: true | false. Presence: always (snapshot only).

override_remaining_s.description: Seconds left in the override window. Reports the FULL window duration when the clock is unsynced, and 0 when expired but not yet processed by the rules tick. Units: seconds. Range/enum: >= 0 when present. Presence: snapshot: OMITTED unless override_active AND remaining >= 0. auto_close_blocked_override event: OMITTED when remaining < 0..

expires_ts.description: Absolute epoch at which the override window expires. Same field name and meaning on both message types. Units: seconds (Unix epoch, UTC). Range/enum: >= 1704067200. Presence: snapshot: OMITTED unless override_active AND the expiry is known/in-future. water_access_override_enabled event: always..

data.description: Type-specific payload container. Created and attached with UNCHECKED cJSON calls in every publisher, so an allocation failure yields a published envelope with NO data key. Presence: always in practice; see note.
